map.输入底涂、中涂、顶涂用量与固含量及涂层密度，计算各层干膜厚度与总厚度，辅助皮革涂: Enter base, middle and top coat usage, solids content and coating density to compute each layer's dry film thickness and the total, supporting leather finishing process control.
map.按各层涂饰用量、固含量与涂饰液密度算出底涂、中涂、顶涂的干膜厚度。: Compute the dry film thickness of base, middle and top coats from each layer's usage, solids content and coating density.
map.累加三层干膜厚度控制总涂饰量，避免涂层过厚导致裂浆或手感发硬。: Sum the three layers' dry film thickness to control total finishing and avoid overly thick coatings causing cracking or a stiff feel.
map.更换涂饰材料（密度/固含量变化）时重算厚度，保持涂层一致。: Recompute thickness when changing finishing materials (density/solids change) to keep the coating consistent.
map.：单层干膜厚度(μm) = 用量(g/m²) × 固含量% ÷ 100 ÷ 密度: : single-layer dry film thickness (μm) = usage (g/m²) × solids% ÷ 100 ÷ density (g/cm³). Derivation: usage times solids gives the solid mass left per m² (g/m²); dividing by density gives volume (cm³/m²), and numerically 1 cm³/m² = 1 μm. Total thickness = base + middle + top coat.
map.为什么用固含量而不是直接用涂布量？: Why use solids content instead of the coating amount directly?
map.涂布量含溶剂/水分，干燥后挥发，真正留在皮面的是固体分；只有乘以固含量才是成膜物: The coating amount includes solvent/water that volatilizes on drying; only the solids remain on the hide. Only multiplying by solids content gives the film-forming matter that determines the final dry film thickness.
map.不是。涂层过厚会掩盖天然粒面、手感发硬，弯曲时易裂浆；一般在满足遮盖与物性要求下: No. An overly thick coating masks the natural grain, feels stiff and cracks when bent; generally make it as thin as possible while meeting coverage and property requirements.
